title: transcribeAnswer fails on empty audio buffer

error_signal.message: vocator-backend TypeError: transcribeAnswer Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length') in screening service audio processing

ground_truth.root_cause_description: transcribeAnswer receives empty or undefined audio buffer when candidate submits without recording. No null check on the buffer before processing.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add null/empty check for audio buffer before processing in transcribeAnswer
